what: Manufacturer recommended retail prices for NEW tractor units sold in Turkiye, used to anchor a used estimate when the corpus has no comparable of that brand.
why: The price model is fit on 84 Turkish listings of which 78 are Ford. A brand it has never seen currently gets only a 1.85x wider band - the widest leave-one-brand-out holdout needed 3.25x at 75% median error. Anchoring on what the truck cost new, times a retention curve fit on the corpus, gives an estimate that does not require a same-brand comparable to exist.
basis: Recommended retail, VAT (20%) and OTV included, standard specification, tractor units (cekici) only. Registration, plates and insurance excluded by every source.
inflation_note: These are TODAY's prices for the CURRENT model, never the historic price of the model year being appraised. Turkish nominal prices move with ~31% CPI, so a 2019 sticker price is not comparable to a 2026 asking price. Both sides of the retention ratio are current, which removes the problem rather than modelling it.
refresh: Hand-curated and stamped, the same posture as USD_TRY in app/config.py. Re-check the source URLs and update as_of; nothing here expires silently, and app.cli doctor reports the age.

Mercedes-Benz Turk's own price page (mercedesbenzturk.com.tr/fiyatlistesi/kamyon/satis/fiyat-listesi) currently publishes no figures - it reads 'Fiyatlarimiz guncellenmektedir'. Actros is the second tractor brand in Turkiye and the likeliest unseen make at judging, so an approximate anchor beats none - but anchor.py widens on source_type.
